records.why: Journal item math_2_2-081 (teacher: use the KICD rubric criteria and prescribed levels, presented in tabular form as in the KICD curriculum design). Deferred: rubric. The KICD 'Suggested Assessment Rubric: Measurements and Geometry' (Grade 10 Mathematics curriculum design, printed pages 37-39, section after Strand 2) has a table with indicators and four levels: Exceeds Expectations, Meets Expectations, Approaches Expectations, Below Expectations. Two indicators cover this sub-strand: 'Ability to identify lines of symmetry of plane figures and properties of reflection' and 'Ability to draw an image given an object and a mirror line on a plane surface and Cartesian plane and determine the equation of the mirror line'. The KICD rubric has no indicator for congruence tests. The partner contract allows only three level fields, so the four-level KICD table cannot be added until the partner extends the contract; the current Final Explanation rubric keeps the round-1 level names in its three descriptors. When the contract allows it, rebuild the rubric from the two KICD indicators (verbatim from the PDF) plus a locally written congruence row marked as not from KICD.
records.resolved_note: Resolved 2026-11-10: the four-level rubric (Below Expectations) is now in this module's Final Explanation (contract revision R1 and the KICD rubric); the deferral no longer applies.
